purpose: Evidence for the focused related-work comparison and added manuscript citations; not an exhaustive novelty search.

sources.title: seismic-bumps
sources.reviewed_material: Official dataset information, variable descriptions and citation metadata.
sources.supports: Next-shift high-energy label, eight-hour summaries, source row/positive counts and feature meanings.
sources.distinction: The displayed 2013 donation date differs from the 2010 citation year; dataset DOI is not the mining article DOI.

sources.title: Application of rule induction algorithms for analysis of data collected by seismic hazard monitoring systems in coal mines
sources.reviewed_material: Original full paper exposed through the author-linked copy: sections 2, 3.5, 4.1 and Table 3.
sources.supports: Longwall-specific shift/hour forecasting, five-fold shift evaluation and cross-longwall transfer.
sources.distinction: Hazard definition and experimental cohorts differ from the public UCI next-shift task; no numerical performance ranking made.

sources.title: The Foundations of Cost-Sensitive Learning
sources.author: Charles Elkan
sources.reviewed_material: Full six-page author manuscript, section 1 decision threshold and section 4 empirical threshold adjustment.
sources.supports: Unequal error costs and probability-based decisions; distinction between calibrated decision thresholds and empirical score cutoffs.
sources.distinction: Project capacity is a hypothetical additional reference-set constraint; monetary costs and intervention value were not measured.

sources.title: Cross-validation strategies for data with temporal, spatial, hierarchical, or phylogenetic structure
sources.reviewed_material: Publisher full text, structured-data discussion and blocking/interpolation/extrapolation sections.
sources.supports: Evaluation design depends on prediction setting and dependence structure.
sources.distinction: The paper does not establish a causal explanation for this repository's AP gap.

sources.title: Detecting and Correcting for Label Shift with Black Box Predictors
sources.reviewed_material: Proceedings metadata and full paper, section 1 factorization and section 3 shift estimation.
sources.supports: Label shift changes class prevalence while retaining class-conditional distributions.
sources.distinction: Frozen project scenarios do not implement BBSE, estimate actual shift or prove this assumption holds.

sources.title: The Jackknife and the Bootstrap for General Stationary Observations
sources.author: Hans R. Kunsch
sources.reviewed_material: Author bibliography, author-deposited abstract and bibliographic metadata. Publisher full-text request was inaccessible.
sources.supports: Method attribution for resampling blocks of dependent observations.
sources.distinction: No new claim about the paper's detailed asymptotic theory or this study's interval coverage is made.

sources.title: On the use of cross-validation for time series predictor evaluation
sources.reviewed_material: Author publication listing and BibTeX; retained general reference, no new performance or priority claim.

sources.title: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
sources.reviewed_material: Original full author paper; establishes adopted method origin rather than project novelty.

sources.title: From local explanations to global understanding with explainable AI for trees
sources.reviewed_material: Retained method reference and author preprint metadata; no additional quantitative claim.
sources.distinction: The author preprint has a different title; published title/year are retained.
